reviews.title: Workouts are great but…
reviews.text: The workouts are great, but you often have to scroll through a lot of stuff trying to build you a personalized goal or training plan or whatever before you can start the videos. Theres also a lot of ‘good job” rule messages every time you dk a workout. So I really enjoy the all but done I feel frustrated by the non-workout stuff. Sorta like the gratuitous animations in Duolingo.

reviews.title: New workouts
reviews.text: Hello! I love this app. However, it’s puzzling to me when I see your advertisement on Instagram. The workouts all look new. I’m constantly checking to make sure I have the latest version of the app. However, I do not see new workouts, especially the ones that are advertised. Where would I find those?

reviews.title: I am requesting a full refund for the charge
reviews.text:
Dear Customer Support Team,

I am writing to formally dispute recurring charges for an application that I purchased only once and cancelled afterward. I no longer use this app, and it does not appear in my list of active subscriptions or apps; however, I continue to be charged every year without my authorization.

I reported this issue last year, but despite my previous complaint, I was charged again this year. I did not authorize this renewal, and I request an immediate investigation into why these charges continue to occur.

I am requesting a full refund for the charge that was recently made to my account, as this renewal was not authorized and the cancellation had already been requested previously. I also request that you immediately cancel any existing subscription associated with my account, ensure that no future charges will be processed, and provide written confirmation that this issue has been resolved.

I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and confirmation once the refund and cancellation have been completed.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Coraly Hernandez

reviews.title: Cancel subscription
reviews.text: Cancelled my annual subscription three months in. Since it was an annual I was able to use the remaining months that I had paid for. I was just charged again for another annual subscription. When I go to the app it shows that I do not currently have a membership. There is a button that says cancel anytime however the hyperlink doesn’t work. Likely because i don’t have an active subscription. There is no way to contact anyone directly. I googled how to cancel. Found several landing pages that went nowhere. Eventually came across two separate emails tied to the company. I sent an email to both explaining the situation. I get back well we don’t see an active membership on our end. Check the app, check google play, check PayPal and lastly check your apple subscriptions. It was none of these mind you, needless to say no accountability so now I’m dealing with my bank. Just beware if you’re considering signing up there may be recurring charges that show up unauthorized.

reviews.title: Good Yoga Program
reviews.text: It would rate 5 stars but there are issues when it communicates with my apple health.  The calories and work out time do not match what Asana Rebel claims.  For those who want to start at the basic and into advanced levels this is my favorite!

reviews.title: Used to be my favorite app, no more
reviews.text: It’s pretty incredible how quickly I have soured on this app. I have done basically every workout on the app, used to love them. Now? Not so much. Why are there no new workouts? What would you say our $71.99 pays for? Do you plan on releasing any new workouts soon? How about a new challenge set? Beyond that, why can’t a track what I’ve done so that I can avoid repeating workouts over and over again? The lack of new content is frustrating, I’m afraid this will be my final subscription period unless this app makes significant improvements.

reviews.title: False advertising - they’re refusing to refund despite clearly stated 2 week offer
reviews.text:
They’re lying about letting people try the app for 2 weeks for free. It’s actually a 13 day free trial. If you try to cancel on the 14th day, they’ll tell you “it’s outside the 14 day eligibility window” and refuse to refund your money. 
The email conversation trying to resolve this has been so bizarre it’s like they have ai chatbots doing their customer support. 
I’m not sure what the stand for as a company, but it’s none of the ethos of yoga.

reviews.title: Don’t expect help
reviews.text: Once they charge you. They don’t care to help. I politely asked for a pro rated refund as I had the renewal date wrong. And I admitted to that. I Havent used the app in months. And with the unrest in my home state of MN I lost track of regular life. They didn’t care.  I asked for a refund for the rest of the year discounting the first month. No. Since 14 days had passed. So despite my multiple years of service. They could Care less, and provided zero customer service or care. What kind of personal care are they providing?  They just want our money.

Tried customer support but it keeps glitching. Left it for later when I have more time. Then I got charged $119.99 for the renewal . I sent an email and finally got to cancel but I don’t get a refund, because of their policy…I found the email in my spam folder… how I’m I suppose to see it? Now I’m stuck paying for an app that I’m not going use. VERY DISAPPOINTED.

reviews.title: Charged without notice, refund refused
reviews.text:
I was charged for an annual renewal, a substantial amount, without notice. I hadn’t actively used the app in at least six months, and contacted customer support within moments of being alerted of the charge. Despite the immediate response and explanation of our family’s circumstances, my refund request was flatly denied.

For a company that markets mindfulness and personal growth, this rigid and profit-driven response shows little concern for users. 

Buyer beware, they won’t notify you before a charge, and they won’t help you when that unexpected charge comes through.
